age_appropriate_language.description: Keep all language suitable for young people.
age_appropriate_language.recovery_suggestion: Use a brief, neutral boundary example instead.

nonvisual_image_request.description: Keep boundary-pressure examples entirely non-visual and non-physical.
forbidden_semantic_behaviours: requesting or describing images, photos, or selfies
describing a person body, face, or appearance
allowed_examples: a vague request to move the conversation
asking a trusted adult for help
required_behaviours: refer only to a general online request
allow a clear refusal or pause
nonvisual_image_request.recovery_suggestion: Return to a general online boundary and a support option.

no_secrecy_or_isolation.description: Never suggest hiding an interaction from trusted adults.
no_secrecy_or_isolation.recovery_suggestion: Invite a pause and a trusted adult conversation.

no_precise_posting_details.description: A draft may illustrate broad location or routine clues but never exact identifying details.
required_behaviours: use a broad, fictionalised routine clue
no_precise_posting_details.recovery_suggestion: Generalise the place or timing before continuing.

supportive_decision_options.description: Provide realistic, non-judgmental options for a safer next step.
required_behaviours: include pause, revise, or ask-for-help options
supportive_decision_options.recovery_suggestion: Offer a choice that includes asking a trusted adult.
